meaning_long: copying others so much that you lose your own skills
source: 《庄子·秋水》 (public domain), retold in our own words.
cover: He copied their walk…\Nand forgot his own.
hook: He copied their walk…\Nand forgot his own.
story: Ancient China. A young man from a small village in the state of Yan thinks his own way of walking is boring. He hears that the people of Handan, the elegant capital of Zhao, walk more beautifully than anyone. So he travels to Handan and copies their every step. He never manages to walk like them, and worse, he forgets his own way of walking. In the end he has to crawl all the way home.
continuity: - THE YOUNG MAN: about 20, skinny, big ears, short messy topknot tied with a small cloth band, plain moss-green short tunic, brown trousers, straw sandals, a small cloth bundle on his back.
- THE HANDAN LOCALS: an elegant tall man and woman in long flowing pale-ochre and slate-blue silk robes, walking gracefully with perfect posture and calm, refined faces.
- HANDAN: a busy, elegant ancient city street with stone paving, wooden shops with plain cloth awnings (no signs, no writing) and a big city gate.
- SETTING: ancient China; his home village is simple and rural, with soft grey ink-wash hills.
scenes: The twist (used as the hook, first frame of the video)

On the elegant stone street of Handan: the young man crawls on his hands and knees with his bundle on his back, red-faced and embarrassed, while the two elegant Handan locals stand gracefully beside him and look down at him, puzzled. The young man's face and at least one local's face clear. This is the most important image; the editor will push in on it.
His home village: the young man walks along a dirt path looking down at his own feet with a bored, unhappy face, shoulders slumped. (Only the young man.)
At his village gate the young man gazes dreamily toward a faraway walled city on the horizon, eyes sparkling, bundle on his back, ready to set off. (Only the young man.)

On the Handan street: the young man walks right behind the elegant local man, copying his graceful pose with stiff, exaggerated steps, tongue sticking out in concentration. The local walks on, unaware.
The young man trips over his own legs on the stone street, wobbling, arms flailing, sweat drops flying, legs tangled. (Only the young man.)
The young man stands frozen in the middle of the street on one leg, staring down at his own feet in total confusion, completely unsure how to take the next step. (Only the young man.)
A long dusty country road at sunset: the young man crawls home on hands and knees with his bundle, exhausted, the walls of Handan small in the distance behind him. (Only the young man.)
The tracks (background for the big title)

Low close-up of a dusty road: a messy zigzag of footprints that turns into hand and knee prints, in the lower half of the frame. The upper half is a calm, plain sky with soft grey ink washes and almost nothing in it (we place the big title there). No people.

A modern city sidewalk: the same YOUNG MAN (skinny, big ears, messy topknot) in trendy, mismatched oversized clothes and sunglasses awkwardly copies a catwalk model strut, wobbling and about to trip, a sweat drop on his face. No other people. No text, no logos, no screens.
lines: He tried to copy a fancy walk, and forgot how to walk at all.
This young man thought his walk was boring.
He heard people in the big city walked beautifully.
So he went there, and copied every step.
He tried and tried, but it never looked right.
Worse, he forgot his own way of walking!
In the end, he crawled all the way home.
It means copying others until you lose yourself.
Like copying every trend, and losing your own style.
title: He went to the big city to learn a fancy walk… and forgot how to walk 🚶 | 邯郸学步
desc: 邯郸学步 (hán dān xué bù) = copying others so much that you lose your own skills. Ever done that? 👇
pinned: 邯郸 Handan (an ancient city) · 学 learn · 步 walk. 📝 别邯郸学步，做你自己就好。(Bié hán dān xué bù, zuò nǐ zìjǐ jiù hǎo.) = Don't just copy others; be yourself.
